caveats: Sea cells are the 3296 region grid cells with finite SST on all 92 target days; other cells (mostly land, 304 of 3600) are 0. Coordinates are the dataset's native float32 grid values on the 0.02-degree grid; the cells nearest the inclusive requested bounds span 56.10-57.28 N and 10.56-11.74 E, fully inside the region. Day 60 (29 Feb) has no pool of its own; its threshold and climatology were set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing, as specified. The baseline pools include the 5-day extensions beyond 1992-2002 (1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05). Thresholds and climatology computed in float64; per-cell MHW runs restricted to and detected only within 2021-06-01..2021-08-31.
